USE WAREHOUSE team_f_wh;
SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT GENDER_NAME) AS genders,
  COUNT(DISTINCT AGE_CATEGORY) AS age_cats,
  COUNT(DISTINCT STATE_NAME) AS states,
  COUNT(DISTINCT REGION) AS regions,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CATEGORY_LEVEL_1) AS cat_l1,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CATEGORY_LEVEL_2) AS cat_l2,
  COUNT(DISTINCT MARRIAGE_STATUS) AS marriage,
  COUNT(DISTINCT PROFESSION_NAME) AS professions,
  COUNT(DISTINCT OCCUPATION_NAME) AS occupations
FROM team_f_db.development.rakuten_purchase_mart_v2
